parameters.query: SELECT (v->>'job_id')::integer AS job_id,(v->>'org_id')::integer AS org_id,v->>'source' AS source FROM gathering_dispatch_v3() v

parameters.jsCode: const q=$input.first().json.query||{}; if(!/^\d+$/.test(String(q.job_id))||!/^\d+$/.test(String(q.org_id))) return {error:true,http_status:400,code:'INVALID_REQUEST',message:'job_id and org_id are required'}; return {job_id:Number(q.job_id),org_id:Number(q.org_id)};

parameters.query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scraping_jobs WHERE id=$1 AND org_id=$2) AS found,coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY r.ordinal) FROM (SELECT ordinal,lead_id,disposition,reason,snapshot FROM gathering_results WHERE job_id=$1 AND org_id=$2 ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4) r),'[]'::jsonb) AS results
